verdict.rationale: Meltano documents a supported framework for building custom connectors: the "SDK for Singer Connectors" and "Build your own Meltano connector". A community user corroborates building a custom tap for a client with the SDK and describes the experience as "top class." The evidence is mostly one-line claims rather than in-depth SDK documentation. Missing for 10: detailed SDK docs covering auth, pagination and schema handling for long-tail APIs; evidence on packaging and registering a custom connector in a project; any low-code builder option.
